ops.title: Phase D — the cc-notes daemon
ops.description:
One global, unsigned, plain-binary daemonkit service. **Never a second agent in the signed helper's plan** — riding `CCNotesHelper.app` is disqualified on a hard constraint: it runs under a hardened runtime, `allow-unsigned-executable-memory` is on `ForbiddenInjectionEntitlements` (`deployment_identity.go:312-320`), and CI hard-fails any entitlement key (`.github/scripts/assert-helper-app.sh:48-51`). wazero's compiler needs writable-executable memory, so inside the helper the engine is categorically interpreter-speed forever.

One process serves N repos as registry-keyed namespaces; per-repo daemons would mean 11 launchd jobs and 11 copies of a 33 MB model. Label `com.yasyf.cc-notes.daemon`, `service.StableProgram` so a brew upgrade does not strand the plist `Program`. Trust: nil-`Requirement` UID-only (the cc-present precedent). IPC: daemonkit `wire` over `~/.cc-notes/daemon.sock`, four unary ops — `index.query.v1` (Concurrent), `index.hint.v1`, `daemon.status.v1`, `daemon.stop.v1`.

The sub-10 ms hook path holds only because it does zero git execs: the client sends its cwd and the daemon resolves cwd→repo from its own registry. One `git rev-parse` would blow the budget alone.

Rebuild trigger is two-tier: an adapted `viz.Watcher` per repo on a slow 30 s tick, plus a best-effort `index.hint` from writers so local writes index in milliseconds. NOT fsnotify — after `pack-refs` the loose files do not exist. Reopen the `gitobj.Repo` on scan error: a daemon-lifetime go-git handle goes stale across a repack, which a one-session viz server never sees.

Layout and repo key: note `acd2aac` §2. `CC_NOTES_HOME` must land in the SAME commit as the first write or the suite pollutes the real home dir.

Companion commit (separate, non-blocking): relocate the fold cache to `~/.cc-notes/repos/<key>/folds-v1/` (one-line change at `internal/store/store.go:145`), fix `GCLocal.liveTips` enumerating 5 of 8 kinds (it silently deletes live fold entries for runbook/sprint/project), and correct the shipped doc that still says `cc-notes/folds/` where the code says `folds-v1`.

ops.text: Runtime reaches Ready and daemon status distinguishes not-installed from installed-but-down
The full test suite is green with no daemon running
The socket path is under the darwin 104-byte sun_path limit
launchctl print shows exactly one new agent and the helper's plan is untouched; assert-helper-app.sh still passes
A hook round-trip measures under 10 ms and performs zero git execs
~/.cc-notes/repos entries for a deleted clone are reaped
